plainTranslation: Their ambitions and public direction press against your feelings, needs, and sense of safety.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their ambitions and public direction press against your feelings, needs, and sense of safety. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
